question: What power arises from continually contemplating a smoke-colored form?
premises: A smoke-colored form is to be contemplated continually.
The triple world is named as the object affected.
The result is the ability to shake it.
inference: By always contemplating a smoke-colored form, one may shake the triple world.
plain_english: O beloved, by always contemplating a smoke-colored form, one can shake the triple world.
